paper_title: Advancing predictive markers in lung adenocarcinoma: A machine learning-based immunotherapy prognostic prediction signature
study_design: Retrospective public-cohort gene screening and survival-model selection with computational immune and drug analyses
evidence_type: Retrospective transcriptomic associations and model-development performance
claim: The reported IPPS contains 13 genes and uses Lasso plus SuperPC selected from 101 candidate combinations.
context: Retrospective development in TCGA-LUAD. Candidate-gene survival screening included TCGA and five GEO cohorts; selection of the final algorithm used the mean C-index in those same five GEO cohorts.
source_locator: Methods 2.2, author-uploaded publisher-layout pp. 2-3; Results 3.1-3.2, pp. 3-5; Figure 1D-E; Figure 2A.
scope_does_not_establish: ["An independently validated predictor of RECIST response or differential benefit from immunotherapy.","Prospective clinical utility or improved outcomes from IPPS-guided treatment.","Unbiased external performance after gene and algorithm selection using the same GEO cohorts.","A reconciled OAK/POPLAR denominator or a resolved GSE31210 AUC estimate.","Experimental drug efficacy or causal functions of the model genes."]
limitations: ["The study is retrospective. Survival-based gene selection used all six TCGA/GEO cohorts, and five GEO cohorts were reused to choose the algorithm. Their results cannot be treated as untouched external validation.","Methods 2.1 states 577 OAK/POPLAR LUAD cases, while Results 3.1 and Figure 1D state a selected 296. The retrieved version does not sufficiently specify the full filtering relationship; no reconciled or pooled denominator is asserted.","Results 3.1 and Figure 1D use OS >12 months and OS <6 months but name the groups CR/PR and PD/SD. Survival strata do not establish objective response categories or differential immunotherapy benefit.","GSE31210 AUCs differ between Results 3.2 (0.67, 0.76, 0.72 at 1, 3, 5 years) and Figure 2L (0.67, 0.73, 0.75). Neither series is adopted as a verified performance estimate.","The TCGA AUCs quoted here are apparent training-cohort estimates. Individual participant data and code were not reanalysed, and no uncertainty interval is invented.","Drug-response analyses are computational. The Discussion uses experimental language, but Methods 2.4 and Results 3.7 describe inference from drug-sensitivity databases.","The author-uploaded publisher-layout text was readable publicly on ResearchGate, and Figures 1 and 2 were visually checked there. Direct PDF download was blocked in this environment; the archived source fingerprint identifies the acquired web transcription, not PDF bytes. No claim is based on an unseen supplementary result."]
single_finding_matrix_scope: ["Bounded retrospective development evidence; no independent treatment-response validation."]
